messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- The reporting service has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-05 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-05]
- The reporting service still relies on the event bus as of 2025-11-13. [valid 2025-11-13 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-13]
- As of 2026-05-01, Ledger deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC instead of on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [decision; valid 2026-05-01 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2026-05-01]
- As of 2025-09-19, the reporting service reads from the event bus instead of querying Ledger directly. [decision; valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Diego held the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, after which Yuki took it over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-11-25, with Yuki off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-10-02, with Diego off rotation. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
    earlier: Diego took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-08-29. [decision; valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-10-02; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-29]
    earlier: Yuki took over the Cinder on-call phone as of 2025-07-22. [decision; valid 2025-07-22 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-07-22]
- The Boreal roster consists of Lena and Marcus Oyelaran as of 2025-01-07. [valid 2025-01-07 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-01-07]
- Farah and Tomasz are the members of Team Dune as of 2025-07-21. [valid 2025-07-21 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-21]
    earlier: Farah is the sole member of Team Dune as of 2025-01-09. [valid 2025-01-09 to 2025-07-21; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-09]
- The product catalog has a deploy window on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC as of 2025-11-12. [constraint; valid 2025-11-12 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-11-12]
    earlier: The product catalog has a deploy window on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-05-02 to 2025-11-12; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-02-2]
- The Postgres 14 pin on Ledger lifts when the partitioning work finishes. [valid 2025-05-30 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-05-30]
- Diego carried the Cinder on-call phone from 2025-11-25 until 2025-12-15, when Yuki took over. [decision; valid 2025-12-15 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-12-15]
    earlier: Diego is back on the Cinder on-call rotation as of 2025-11-25, carrying the phone until the next rotation. [decision; valid 2025-11-25 to 2025-12-15; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-11-25]
    earlier: Diego is off the Cinder on-call rotation as of 2025-10-02. [decision; valid 2025-10-02 to 2025-11-25; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-10-02]
- The reporting service must stay on Python 3.11 until the pandas 3 upgrade lands. [constraint; valid 2025-05-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-15]
- The product catalog lived with the Cinder team from 2025-01-17 until 2025-10-20, when it moved to the Boreal team. [valid 2025-10-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-20-catalog]
    earlier: The product catalog lives with the Cinder team as of 2025-01-17. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-10-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- Tomasz was on call for Team Dune from 2025-09-04 until 2025-11-03, when Farah took over as primary. [decision; valid 2025-11-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-03]
    earlier: Tomasz is on call for Team Dune as of 2025-09-04, after Farah handed him the pager. [valid 2025-09-04 to 2025-11-03; recorded by standup/dune/2025-09-04]
    earlier: Farah is on call for Team Dune as of 2025-03-31. [valid 2025-03-31 to 2025-09-04; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-31]
- The flags service saw 40,000 requests per second at peak, and most of the requests were identical. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- The reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy, as noticed by Cinder on 2025-08-20. [valid 2025-08-20 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-08-20]
- The reporting service was moved off direct Ledger queries because nightly Ledger scans were blocking billing runs. [valid 2025-09-19 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-19]
- Ledger only ships on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-02-28]

Question: Which note corrected the recorded owner of reporting, and when?
